name: arxa-push-doorbell
description: The engine-side push doorbell (arxa/docs/plans/doorbell-decision-2026-08-29.md, option B1): one minimal caller that POSTs loopback /v1/send to the desktop's cairn-pushd sidecar for the approval-requested event class. Pure-library plugin — nothing registers into cordis until the approvals feature gains a call site. Config-gated off by default (ARXA_DOORBELL_PUSH=true); device tokens come from the desktop's pairing.json, the bearer from pushd.env, both overridable by env. Never throws into the engine: every failure is a logged, counted no-op.
